question: Do the s016c_prime cohort-selector winners hi-fi-validate as Band A∪B (multi-solution acceptance), meeting the >=4/7 threshold?
hypothesis: At least 4/7 cohort-selector winners render Band A∪B in hi-fi, salvaging the joint-search architecture via multi-solution acceptance.
narrative_md: Hi-fi ρ-band of the 7 s016c_prime cohort-selector winners. 3/7 validate as Band A∪B (seeds 13, 41 Band A; 79 Band B); 4/7 fall Band C∪D. Threshold was ≥4/7 → DECISION: C_PRIME_KILLED, the multi-solution reframe is rejected for this joint-search architecture. Top-3 adds zero coverage. Predictions matched all 7 seeds. Secondary finding: off-truth-ω hi-fi/surrogate MSE ratio is 3-5x wider than s014's truth-ω reference, though rank order is preserved.
